## Review checklist

- [ ] The change stays within the approved step/feature scope.
- [ ] Non-goals remain out of scope.
- [ ] Public APIs, formats, and scientific semantics are unchanged, or an ADR/version bump/fixtures were added.
- [ ] Tests exercise observable behaviour with real objects/files where practical.
- [ ] New dependencies are justified, pinned, and licence-checked.
- [ ] Generated contract artifacts were regenerated, not hand-edited.
- [ ] Step page, status dashboard, parity matrix, and documentation pages are current.
- [ ] No unrelated formatting or refactor changes are included.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or copied GPL source/data are included.
